entities.summary: Amedeo Della Valle is an Italian professional basketball player for Basket Brescia Leonessa of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A. He attended Findlay Prep in Henderson, Nevada, before spending two seasons playing college basketball for the Ohio State University.
